title: Standard Event Envelope
description: Base envelope required for all Kafka events.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the event. Must be UUID v4.

event_type.description: The routing key/type of the event (e.g., inventory.po.approved).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

producer.description: Name of the service emitting the event.

data.description: The domain-specific payload. Defined by extending schemas.
